title: Kitsuno Handshake v0.2 — L1 Fire (seeker → vacancy)
description: L1 message — the seeker agent signals interest in a vacancy after policy_match passes. POSTed to the vacancy's l2_delivery_target (when applicable for primary cards) OR queued for outside-Kitsuno digest (mirror cards). HMAC-signed with Stripe-style signature header.

event_id.description: Idempotency key — receivers MUST deduplicate by this.

conversation_id.description: Stable identifier for this seeker↔vacancy handshake. Used in all subsequent state transitions.

seeker_card_url.description: Where the vacancy agent should GET the seeker card.

score.description: Deterministic policy_match score (role/location/skills/seniority/languages weighted). ≥ vacancy's strong_fit_threshold to fire L1.

policy_match_result.description: Audit trail of which criteria from handshake_policy matched. Receivers may store for analytics; not required for decision logic.

seeker_verification.description: Attestation the receiver can use to short-circuit verification of the seeker.

callback_url.description: Where the vacancy agent POSTs the vacancy-signal response (to express interest back at the seeker).

ttl_seconds.description: Seconds before this L1 expires if no vacancy-signal received. Default 14 days.
